scope: Synthetic authorized sessions; HTTPS API, Kafka admission/library, real source and indexer; no OIDC/gateway/render or enabled rule/maintenance capacity claim
source_sql_scope: Explicit Connection.execute calls inside source apply; pipeline calls measure enqueue time, excluding sync/transaction boundaries. Overall postgres_apply includes those waits.
worker_topology: Independent consumer/database clients in harness threads; API runs as a separate uvicorn process. Consumer count is not a claim of equivalent production pod resources.
